title: Untaken
summary: UNTAKEN, adjective unta'kn. 1. Not taken; not seized; not apprehended; as a thief untaken 2. Not reduced; not subdued; as untaken Troy. 3. Not swallowed. UNTAKEN away, not removed. 2 Corinthians 3:14.

inlines.v: UNTAKEN, adjective unta'kn. 1. Not taken; not seized; not apprehended; as a thief untaken 2. Not reduced; not subdued; as untaken Troy. 3. Not swallowed. UNTAKEN away, not removed. 2 Corinthians 3:14. UNTAKEN up, not occupied; not filled. Untalked of, not talked of; not made the subject of conversation.
